geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the overly abstract bend-driven object with a section-aware massing operator so the building can express a clearer program section and terrace logic.
Use a folded profile to create a legible roof/section condition suited to neighborhood living and terrace/public void organization.
Orient the section logic along the long axis so the mass can read as a coherent street building rather than a compact sculptural stack.
Keep a controlled upper projection but reduce the sense of an overbearing cap so the ground remains more available and legible.
Slightly tune the overhang to create a more readable seam at the access edge without producing a collision or detached fragment.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the primary mass from a generic stepped block into a more explicit court-form generator so the building can organize a real public void.
Open a usable court proportion without hollowing the whole mass.
Align the public opening to the verified access side in program frame so the ground threshold responds to frontage.
Lower the terrace link so the access edge reads as a more immediate public seam instead of a sealed upper gesture.

rationale: The candidate reads as a single compact brown mass in all views, but the dominant language is a stacked/stepped object rather than a neighborhood building that actively shapes ground public space. The parcel is respected, and the form is at least internally consistent across the four views, but the road frontage edge is answered weakly: there is no convincing court, seam, or undercut aligned to the verified access edge, and the visible mass tends toward a sealed object. The embedded BOOK-like cuts do not produce a legible public void; they read more as clipped subtraction than usable shared space. Program-wise, neighborhood living needs an active threshold and a clear public void or terrace, neither of which is established with enough clarity here. The mass also feels closer to an abstract terraced sculpture or hill-like civic object than a compact mixed-use street building, so program_fit_hard_pass fails.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is more campus/community-center than compact neighborhood living; it should inform void-and-connection logic, not scale or complexity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-linked, low-rise civic massing with terraced/bridging circulation that keeps a legible public interior open to the ensemble.
